approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: A synthetic EML with two distinct Message-ID headers currently loses both primary identities and is displayed as an ordinary SINGLE email thread.
Preserve only hashed identity metadata, reuse the existing ambiguity state and warning path, add no dependency, semantic inference, mailbox access or model call.
Parser, workflow, API, task-context, specification, manifest and full repository checks passed offline with no model or external request.
title: Conflicting email Message-ID detection
objective: Mark an email with multiple distinct Message-ID values as an ambiguous thread using hash-only metadata, without changing valid single-ID, no-ID, RFI or Submittal relationships.
